rationale: An independent strongest conventional max-pooling control that exactly matches the known OR inductive structure is required, otherwise raw additive logistic regression could be a strawman. This arm is declared before evaluating any world.

new_control.name: conventional_maxpool_logistic
new_control.training: Use identical fully converged L2=0.03 Newton-solved 10-example conventional logistic model from prereg; no additional labels, training steps or hyperparameter tuning.

new_control.metrics: Same post-action and counterfactual change accuracies, fit/transfer and cold exact replay as all other arms
new_control.interpretation: If max-pooling equals numeric direct and independent symbolic, do not claim superior intelligence. Exact equality to a strong structural inductive baseline is a scientifically useful null.
